S6_05_ARITHMETIC.notes: Exact ODE coefficient recurrences, Cauchy tails, and one positive Bernstein polynomial. Independent exact integer/rational arithmetic verifies all finite scalar inequalities.

S6_05_ARITHMETIC.statement: W=0 exactly on the i and rho modular orbits; 3W wpprime-2g2=0 exactly on the rho orbit. L decreases strictly on every ray from t=1; no other coarse critical point; every lower level is one star-shaped Jordan curve.
S6_05_ARITHMETIC.notes: The suggested saddle in 0<t<1 does not exist. t=0 is noncritical C1 on the coarse base but a cubic degenerate critical point on its root chart; t=1 is the unique maximum, nondegenerate on its h chart.

S6_05_ARITHMETIC.statement: A nontorsion elliptic extension by Gm has endomorphism ring Z. For E361 and Q=2P the compact slope c=zeta(u)-eta1*u/omega1 is real transcendental; hypothetical algebraic N gives an algebraic compact lift on a Lie line not defined over Qbar. Functional Ax-Schanuel gives the full three-dimensional graph and no contradiction.
S6_05_ARITHMETIC.depends_on: C.4; C.6.R1; C.7.1; C.7.2; Huber-Wustholz Theorem 6.1; Noguchi 2024 Theorem 1.3
S6_05_ARITHMETIC.notes: Dual and Rosati conventions explicit; Hom(E,Gm)=0 removes lift ambiguity; doubling and real logarithm signs checked. This obstruction does not settle the Gaussian norm transcendence question.

S6_05_ARITHMETIC.statement: For the CM-stable fibre product G_Q times_E G_(beta Q), Hom(G,Gm)=0 and End(G) tensor Q=Q(beta). An explicit algebraic antisymmetric compact lift and a hypothetical diagonal compact lift isolate the Gaussian in the minus-beta Lie eigencoordinate; no algebraic quasi-endomorphism or rational polynomial limit realizes that projector.
S6_05_ARITHMETIC.depends_on: C.7.1; C.7.2; C.7.6; C.7.9; analytic subgroup theorem
S6_05_ARITHMETIC.notes: Exact CM matrix and projector displayed; approximation has uniform spectral error at least 1/2. The missing step is algebraicity of the projected exponential, not existence of the Lie projector.

S6_05_ARITHMETIC.statement: The complexified norm has a rank-four paired period/CM value set in a fixed field under norm algebraicity. Its cancelling algebraic first-direction jet has a transcendental second jet, and the displayed derivative-free several-variable criterion fails its exact numerical inequality.
S6_05_ARITHMETIC.depends_on: C.7.1; C.7.6; C.7.7; C.7.9; C.7.10; Waldschmidt1975Theorem1; Waldschmidt2009Theorems3.6-3.7
S6_05_ARITHMETIC.notes: Exact fixed-field squaring and automorphy proved. On E361 at Q the second jet ratio is 4*pi/A-8. The main norm algebraicity question remains undecided.

S6_05_ARITHMETIC.statement: Conditional norm algebraicity propagates to the CM division hull; real and complex division values have explicit polynomial degree envelopes and uniformly bounded heights. Finite translate families have transcendence-degree cap three over Qbar. The resulting proved envelopes do not verify the variable-degree GMW1986 criterion; arithmetic-germ criteria fail the transcendental tangent hypothesis.
S6_05_ARITHMETIC.depends_on: C.4.2; C.7.6; C.7.9; GMW1986Theorem2.1; Herblot2012Theorem6.1; Gasbarri2010Theorem4.16
S6_05_ARITHMETIC.notes: Real bound D*n^4; complex bound 2*D*n^6; fixed translate family bound O(n^5). GMW certificate comparisons N^12 versus N^3 and N^20 versus N^6 do not establish any actual degree lower bound. Norm algebraicity for E361 remains undecided.
